title: Titanium Eductor Nozzle
function: Venturi eductor nozzle for tank mixing
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Eductor Nozzle where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Venturi eductor nozzle for tank mixing requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by venturi eductor nozzle for tank mixing and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for tank hardware geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with SPC sampling
Pickling and passivation with SPC sampling
Continuity test <1 mOhm with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for venturi eductor nozzle application
inspection: Adhesion tape ASTM D3359 (venturi eductor verified)
commonFailures: Contact burn at rack hook from insufficient clamp - resolved by BeCu spring contact 5N minimum force — critical for venturi eductor nozzle performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium Eductor Nozzle resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium Eductor Nozzle resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for venturi eductor nozzle.

faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Eductor Nozzle is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Eductor Nozzle?
faq.a: Each Titanium Eductor Nozzle shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for venturi eductor nozzle.
